title: Skills' opening selfdoc section reads run in a worktree session
goal: No skill's opening selfdoc.py section command names the doc as a bare git argument that a worktree session's guard reads as a second git call: kb-sprint and every skill that reads git "Workflow" pass it as git.md (or split the read), and a test checks that no SKILL.md passes a bare git doc name to selfdoc.py section. Answers the SP-rhgeod5g failure: kb-sprint's first command was refused in a worktree session because the command 'names git more than once'.
